messages:
From: Alexandra King <ak@brightflow.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — trial runway & usage buffer for StrikeZone pilot

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday — the StrikeZone team is excited about the integration. We ran some throughput tests this morning and hit a couple of limits on our side that mean we need more wall-clock time to finish the last two flows (fine-tuning the prompt set + a small reranking loop).

Two asks from our side to keep momentum and push toward contract signature by July:
- Can we get a 30-day extension on the pilot window? We need the additional dev time to validate latency-sensitive flows.
- Would Redwood consider a small one-time usage credit (not a long-term discount) to cover the estimated extra tokens for our extended run — ballpark 150k tokens. This will help get internal procurement comfortable with a go/no-go by the end of next month.

We know this is an end-of-quarter tug; we appreciate anything that helps us keep momentum. Happy to jump on a quick call if you want details.

Best,
Alexandra King
Head of Platform
BrightFlow.ai

[Attachment: strikezone-flow-metrics.csv (csv)]

Subject: Re: Quick ask — trial runway & usage buffer for StrikeZone pilot

Alexandra — thanks for the summary and for sharing the metrics.

Looping in Monica (CS) and Markus (Sales Ops) so we can get an approved, short-form offer back to you today. Monica — can you confirm the scope of the extension and what we can safely offer as a one-time conversion incentive that aligns with the DF-1172 deal band?

Markus — if there’s a finance/approval template you want me to include, flag it and I’ll attach.

I’ll stay on standby for a quick sync if useful.

Cheers,
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-24T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — trial runway & usage buffer for StrikeZone pilot

Connor — recommended approach:
1) Approve a 30-day pilot extension (no product changes).
2) Offer a one-time conversion credit equal to $8,000 applied against first-month usage after conversion OR a token credit equivalent for the pilot (whichever the customer prefers). This maps to the DF-1172 approval slab for Strategic mid-market.
3) Add a clause: credit usable only if the account signs a minimum 12-month committed plan within 60 days of the pilot end.

Rationale: keeps economics contained, creates a clear conversion trigger, and ties spend to a committed contract.

I recommend we attach a short approval memo and route to finance for sign-off.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Subject: StrikeZone pilot — approved one-time conversion credit and extension

Alexandra — quick update: Redwood can approve a 30-day extension to the pilot window and a one-time conversion credit of $8,000 (applied to your first paid month after conversion) OR a token-based credit equivalent for the pilot run. The credit is conditional on BrightFlow signing a 12-month committed plan within 60 days after the extended pilot ends.

We’ve attached the internal approval memo for transparency and the one-page terms worksheet. If that sounds good, I’ll have our legal team draft an addendum / short MOU for signatures (DocuSign link to follow).

Proposed next steps:
- Reply to confirm that BrightFlow chooses cash-credit vs token-credit preference.
- I’ll send the addendum and target a signature by next week so procurement can budget.
- Monica will schedule a 30-minute assist session to help wrap the remaining integration checks.

Thanks — we want to make this as frictionless as possible so you can demonstrate the flows to your retention team before the quarter close.
